slice: Current-source ARM64 Kernel application software smoke

build.command: docker buildx build --progress plain --platform linux/arm64 --target kernel --build-arg KOKONUT_CLICKHOUSE=false --load --tag kokonut-kernel-current-arm64-e9d68670:local --file Dockerfile.kernel .

runtime_smoke.command: docker run --rm --platform linux/arm64 --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=64m -v <repository>/sdk/python:/sdk:ro -e PYTHONPATH=/sdk -e PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 --entrypoint python3 kokonut-kernel-current-arm64-e9d68670:local -c '<imports and Gateway construction>'

limitations: QEMU software-emulation evidence only; no physical Raspberry Pi, power-loss, thermal, performance, or storage-endurance acceptance.
The container had no network, a read-only root, a 64 MiB temporary /tmp, and only a read-only Python SDK source mount.
The temporary image was built for this smoke and is removed after evidence capture.
